supportLevel: Unofficial public Microsoft Fabric status mirror based on HTML scraping

active.detailsHtml: Power BI customers may experience failures when creating new Adobe Analytics connections or updating credentials for existing connections, resulting in the error: “DataSource.Error: This API endpoint has been discontinued.” As a workaround, Customers can create the Adobe Analytics connection through Dataflows Get Data and then use that connection with their Semantic Model. Engineers have identified the root cause and a fix for the issue will be deployed by end-of-day 09/14/2026.
